item.description:

Hebrew Channel 13: Following the imposition of US sanctions on Iran, the latter sent messages to the UAE and Saudi Arabia: Evacuate the US bases in your countries or you will be subjected to an attack. Israeli estimates indicate that if the Iranian threat materializes, the likelihood of a war breaking out will increase.
